raw_text: PHP 8.4+ syntax only; Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file; Make all classes final unless inheritance is required; Use readonly properties wherever possible; Use constructor property promotion; Use typed properties and return types; Follow PSR-12; Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code; DTOs are `final readonly`; Requests extend `Saloon\Http\Request`; Requests are `final`; Member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth` trait; All responses should be typed using Data DTOs; `composer test`; `composer lint`; `composer test:unit`; `composer test:types`; `composer refactor`.
